title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
headline: REACT.JS | NODE.JS | NESTJS | TYPESCRIPT | POSTGRESQL | AWS
summary: Senior Full Stack Engineer with 7+ years of experience building fintech and lending platforms end to end, from responsive React.js frontends to Node.js and NestJS APIs on PostgreSQL and AWS. Led greenfield delivery of a multi-product trade finance suite spanning broker, investor, and reporting portals, and cut loan processing times from 6 minutes to 1–2 minutes through asynchronous service design.
